title: 500 Friends But No One to Play With
description: Connect with others (and yourself) with intention and play to bring more (choose one: interest, fun, fulfillment, creativity) into your life. This course will feel like a book club and playdates with fieldwork mixed in. Throughout the semester, you will explore how the designed environment influences your connections; reconnect with the power of play (doing something just for the enjoyment of it); and actively experiment with design skills like noticing and experimentation to build your curiosity, confidence, and connection in ways that matter to you.
